The following events took place in '''14,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*Some pure [[Blood/Legends|blooded]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|ancient Sith]] begin their slumber in [[Krayiss II]]'s [[Krayiss Two library-temple|library-temple]]. Their [[Force ghost/Legends|spirits]] haunt the Temple for at least 10,000 years to come.<ref name="TftDS">{{WEGCite|story=A Tale from the Dark Side|book=Tales of the Jedi Companion}}</ref>
*The noble house, [[House Korden]], is established.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>
*Around this date, [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] explorers discovered the [[Sneevel/Legends|Sneevel]] species.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', entry "Sneevel".</ref>
